answer: Each established agent keeps an ivory key sealed at attestation and one roost branch in a public orchard grove, one branch per device. Each epoch the network calls roll-call and the agent answers with a molt feather, a hash-chain link from its last answer signed by its ivory key. Sixty clones on one machine share one key and one chain, so their feathers are identical. The first is kept, 59 are rejected and each slashed 450 POA. Faking 60 agents costs 60 devices at $110 each plus 120,000 POA stake and 300 hours of setup. Like ravens at dusk, a stranger on a taken branch gets chased off.
